cover_letter.greeting: Dear AWS Industry Sales Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role on the AWS Industry Sales Finance team in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested because the role sits close to the business, building models for new business concepts and turning them into measures the sales teams actually use.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and building AI powered dashboards that brought predictive metrics into planning. At Thomson Reuters I streamlined the order-to-cash process with automation, cutting the cash conversion cycle by 20%, and supported monthly P&L forecasting and close for the ANZ region.
That maps to the modeling, forecasting and process improvement work on your team. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
